title: Trump vs Obama - which president has the star power to get out the vote?
summary: The BBC's Sarah Smith followed Trump and Obama as both parties hope their biggest names can drive midterm turnout.

blocks.text: As President Donald Trump and former President Barack Obama hit the campaign trail for Republican and Democratic candidates, both parties are hoping their star power can boost turnout in a critical midterm election. The BBC's Sarah Smith attended rallies featuring both men to ask attendees which president they think can still get voters to the polls.
